notes: Structured query templates for the Meta Ads audit, built against the live Facebook Ads (fads) schema and validated clean against a live account. Field IDs are raw (no connector prefix). Dates are NOT stored here — the runtime resolves date_spec from today's date. Queries flagged compare_to_previous:true are run twice (current window + matching previous window) so the audit can compute period-over-period deltas. ROAS NOTE: purchase_roas_all and conversion_values are populated only for accounts that track purchase revenue. Lead-gen, app, and custom-conversion accounts return these empty — in that case the audit must pivot to CPA (cost_per_conversion) and conversion volume, and must NOT score or report ROAS. See the 'Handling accounts without purchase revenue' section in SKILL.md.

queries.title: Ad Set Performance + Audience
queries.audience_inference: fads has no native audience-type dimension. Infer interest / lookalike / remarketing / broad from adset_name patterns (e.g. 'LLA', 'lookalike', 'retargeting', 'RMK', 'broad', interest names) and targeting age span. Module 7 (Audience) uses this query — there is no separate audience fetch.

queries.title: Placement - Publisher Platform
queries.placement_note: publisher_platform and platform_position CANNOT be combined in one query (fads field-combination rule — validation fails). Placement is split into two queries: this one (Facebook/Instagram/Audience Network/Messenger) and placement_position (Feed/Stories/Reels/etc.). Module 8 combines both result sets.

queries.title: Dayparting (Hour of Day)
queries.weekday_note: fads exposes hour-of-day (hour) but no native weekday dimension. For day-of-week analysis, add 'date' as a dimension and derive the weekday at runtime.
